lines.t: Shh…
Let the noise fall.
Let the light in.
(Your peace… Your peace…)
Bass down low, hands up high
Lord, You hold me through the night.
P—E—A—C—E,
Lord, put Your peace in mee-ee-ee.
World gets loud, but my soul stays free,
Oh-oh-oh, You’re my melody.
P—E—A—C—E,
In Your love, I can bree-ee-eathe.
Every fear, I now release
I move, I move in the Lord’s peace.
I move, I move in the Lord’s peace.
(Peace! Peace! In the Lord’s peace!)
Phone lights up, another headline,
Mind runs laps at the wrong time.
Smile on my face, got a storm underneath,
Been holding my breath when I’m trying to speak.
Then I turn to You, let the room go still,
Don’t need control just to know You’re real.
Open my hands, let the tight grip ease,
Got a heart full of noise Lord, cover me.
(Cover me…)
Not every road gets smooth by dawn,
But I don’t have to walk alone.
You meet me here, no mask, no show
Your love’s my rest when the sparks still fly.
I don’t need to see the whole way,
Just enough light for the next step.
When tomorrow tries to call my name,
I come back to Your love instead.
Breathe in slow…
Let it go…
Lord, You’re closer than I know.
(One, two—let it flow!)
P—E—A—C—E,
Lord, put Your peace in mee-ee-ee.
World gets loud, but my soul stays free,
Oh-oh-oh, You’re my melody.
P—E—A—C—E,
In Your love, I can bree-ee-eathe.
Every fear, I now release—
I move, I move in the Lord’s peace.
(Peace! Peace! In the Lord’s peace!)
Peace in my step—step, step.
Rest in my chest—yes, yes.
Hands up, lay that burden down,
Lord, Your love’s my steady ground.
P—E! (P—E!)
A—C—E! (A—C—E!)
Who’s got peace?
Your peace in me!
Clap-clap, snap—let the pressure fall back,
No, I’m not taking that old weight back.
Used to let a bad day write my whole way,
Now I bring it to You; I don’t feed that flame.
Still got questions, still got tears,
Still hear noise, but it doesn’t steer.
Faith in my feet when the floor feels thin,
I can take one step, then a step again.
No perfect pose, no polished prayer,
Just “Lord, I need You”—You meet me there.
I don’t need a trophy I chase till I break;
You’re the One I turn to when my hands shake.
(I turn to You…)
Deep bass rolls, let the dark room bloom,
There’s a little more light when I make You room.
Let the whole crowd sing till the rafters ring:
All this joy from the peace You bring!
When the music fades,
When the room goes quiet,
You’re the One I seek,
Not just a passing feeling.
I lay down the weight
I was never meant to keep.
Lord, receive my heart
Teach my soul to rest in peace.
Teach my soul to rest in peace.
(Rest in You… rest in You…)
P—P—P—peace!
E—E—ease!
A—C—E—
Your peace in me!
Breathe.
P—E—A—C—E,
Lord, put Your peace in mee-ee-ee.
World gets loud, but my soul stays free,
Oh-oh-oh, You’re my melody.
(You’re my melody!)
P—E—A—C—E,
In Your love, I can bree-ee-eathe.
Every fear, I now release
I move, I move in the Lord’s peace.
(Your peace! Your peace!)
Peace in my step…
Rest in my chest…
Lord, in Your love,
I don’t have to run.
P—E—A—C—E…
Your peace in me.
“World gets loud…”
P—E—A—C—E,
Lord, put Your peace in mee-ee-ee.
Let that bass drop; fear, release
I move, I move in the Lord’s peace.
Peace in my step—step, step.
Rest in my chest.
